To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the breast progenitor cancer-derived PMC42 cell line exhibits normal-like mRNA and miRNA transcriptomes; (2) the mechanism leading to miRNA loss in PMC42 has genomic, transcription, and post-transcript components; (3) we propose that, despite their neoplastic origin PMC42 is an exceptional molecular model for normal mammary epithelial cells.
PMC42, a neoplastic breast cancer cell line, is a good model system for normal breast tissue because of its normal-like mRNA and miRNA transcriptome.
